annotations.text:
Redesign — app shell direction.

New: sidebar with live facets, sticky top bar, card results with elevation, indigo accent, Schibsted Grotesk + IBM Plex Mono.

Main and AsOf are live. Type in the search box, hit Rules, click the clock for as-of, drag the slider.

Dark toggle sits above each artboard.

The change that fixed 'too text-heavy':

STATE became a pill you recognise. Only the CONSEQUENCE gets words — and 'in force · current' has no consequence line at all, because there is nothing to act on.

Everything else demoted to a chip row.

Unchanged from the first pass — the flows were not the problem.

Each names the moment the product fails quietly. Flow A is the one the whole design rests on: the top hit is rescinded and still ranks first.
